prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 e-commerce discount card for a Telegram channel. Flat, modern, premium. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape covering the top ~20% of the frame.

Use the attached product photo as the hero image. Keep the product exactly as it is — do not redraw, restyle or alter it; only cut it out cleanly from its background.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1) Top row of pills: left — a solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "AMAZON" (plain text, no logo); next to it — a white pill with a thin light-grey border and grey text "AQSh"; right edge — a solid crimson (#E11D48) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "CHEGIRMA".
2) A large white rounded rectangle (24px radius) with a soft realistic drop shadow, about 40% of the frame height. The product photo centered inside it, with a soft studio shadow beneath.
3) Overlapping the top-right corner of that rectangle: a solid crimson (#E11D48) circle with a thin white outer ring. Inside, in white: large bold "-25%" and beneath it small uppercase "CHEGIRMA".
4) Headline in bold near-black (#11111B), large: "Beats Solo 4"
5) Price row: very large bold indigo (#4F46E5) "$149.95" and immediately to its right, smaller grey "$199.95" with a horizontal strikethrough line.
6) A light grey (#F6F6FB) rounded panel with a thin border containing:
   - small bold indigo uppercase label: "NARX SOLISHTIRUVI"
   - row: left grey text "O'zbekistonda (Asaxiy)", right bold near-black "2 289 000 so'm"
   - row: left grey text "Chetdan (tovar+yetkazish+boj)", right bold indigo "1 883 000 so'm"
   - a thin divider line
   - row: left bold green (#059669) uppercase "TEJAYSIZ", right large bold green (#059669) "406 000 so'm"
7) Bottom, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right smaller grey "Chegirmalar - Kuryerlik - Bojxona"

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes:
